title: Chamber Music: A Journey Through Love and Poetry
author: James Joyce
description:
In the throes of young love, a vibrant voice emerges, capturing the tender complexities of romance and longing. In "Chamber Music," James Joyce weaves together 36 evocative poems that explore the exhilaration and heartache of falling in love. Each piece resonates with rich imagery and melody, reflecting the passionate yearnings of a young man navigating the intricate dance of affection.

As you immerse yourself in these lyrical verses, you’ll discover not just the beauty of love but also its challenges. Joyce’s delicate language paints a vivid picture of fleeting moments, whispered secrets, and the bittersweet nature of relationships. The themes of desire, vulnerability, and emotional awakening echo throughout, inviting you to reflect on your own experiences of love.

Listeners will appreciate how these poems transcend their original form, inspiring composers and artists alike. Each work pulses with rhythm, making them ideal for those who revel in poetry that feels alive. While the collection captures the essence of youth, it also poses timeless questions about connection and self-discovery.

Join Joyce on this intimate journey, and let his masterful words stir your heart and imagination. With "Chamber Music," you're not just hearing poetry; you're experiencing the symphony of love’s many facets.

You’re great at what you do. It’s time more people knew it.

This space is all about connection through creative expression and slowing down enough to talk about what's really going on beneath the surface. Our mission is to shed light on the best mantras in life, the ones that carry us through dark times and aluminate the path ahead. title: The Probate Real Estate Brief with Marc Cormier
author: Marc
description:
The Probate Real Estate Brief with Marc Cormier provides simple, practical answers to the real estate questions families face during probate, inheritance, and estate administration.


What happens to a house when someone dies? Can a personal representative or executor sell a home during probate? Should an inherited property be sold as-is or repaired first? What happens when heirs disagree? How should families handle clean-outs, vacant properties, reverse mortgages, liens, repairs, and preparing an estate property for sale?


Each short episode tackles one real-world question and explains the real estate side in plain English.

Marc Cormier is a Probate and Downsizing REALTOR® with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices PenFed Realty and more than 25 years of real estate experience. Marc and his team help personal representatives, executors, heirs, families, attorneys, trustees, seniors, and homeowners navigate complicated real estate situations.


Marc serves Montgomery County, Prince George’s County, and Howard County, Maryland; Washington, D.C.; and Arlington, Fairfax, and Loudoun counties in Northern Virginia.


Learn more and find probate real estate guides, resources, episode transcripts, and sources at ProbateFAQ.com.


Episodes may use an AI-generated narrator. Information and editorial direction are provided and reviewed by Marc Cormier.


Disclaimer: This podcast is for general educational and informational purposes only. Marc Cormier is a real estate professional, not an attorney, CPA, financial advisor, or lender. Consult the appropriate qualified professional regarding your specific circumstances.

A little more about me. A little more English for you.
Welcome to my audio journal! I’m Letícia, an English teacher, mother, language learner, International Trade student, and founder of Another Level Language School.
In each episode, I share a little piece of my life: personal stories, everyday moments, memories, and things I’m still figuring out.

You don’t need to understand every word. Follow the story, get curious, and listen again whenever you like.
Real life. Everyday English. A little more, one episode at a time.

title: A Manifesto of Fruitfulness: Stories
author: Church of the City New York
description:
New York disciples its people through ambition. Etched into the walls of Moynihan Train Hall, the newly renovated front door to the city, is a single word from the New York State seal: Excelsior. It's Latin for "ever upward," and while meant as civic pride showcasing New York's history of excellence, said honestly, in the context of most people's lives in the city, "ever upward" feels more like a mandate than a cheer.
Most people here live pinned between two unsatisfying options—apathy or ambition—with both ending in defeat.
Jesus offers a third way: fruitfulness. He makes the uncomfortable contrast between what a person produces and what a person's life produces in somebody else, and in turn, the Kingdom.
Over eleven weeks, we will hear about the 100x life God intends to cultivate in His disciples.

You may know my name. You don’t know my whole story.

I’m Kelly, and I’ve been a soldier, a wife, a mother, a business owner, a friend, and a woman who has learned that life rarely goes exactly according to plan. And at this great age, I’m still discovering who I am - and who I’m becoming.


Each episode brings real stories and honest conversations about marriage, motherhood, friendships, family, major weight loss, business, reinvention, getting older, starting over, and those moments that make you stop and ask, “Wait…whooo am I now?”


Sometimes it’ll be funny. Sometimes it’ll get personal. Sometimes we may go somewhere I didn’t expect.


Because this isn’t a podcast about having life figured out.


It’s about having lived enough life to finally tell the stories.


This is Kelly Whooo?

It’s about building a bigger life, not just a bigger business.

Tiff + Cody explore love, friendship, belief, marriage, parenting, sex, money, identity, spirituality and everything in between with curiosity, honesty, and a willingness to admit when we have absolutely no idea.

As Nancy delves deeper into this gripping mystery, she uncovers clues that point to a much larger conspiracy. What secrets lie hidden within the walls of the bungalow? Why does Laura’s guardian seem to have a sinister agenda? Listeners will find themselves on the edge of their seats as Nancy employs her sharp wit and resourcefulness to untangle the threads of this complex case.

Join Nancy on her high-speed chase filled with unexpected twists, clever deductions, and the unbreakable bonds of friendship. Will she outsmart the danger and save Laura in time? These fierce little people, with their own customs and conflicts, present both a challenge and an opportunity for the legendary lord of the jungle. As Tarzan navigates their world, he grapples with the balance between power and wisdom, forcing him to confront not only their warlike nature but his own instincts as a protector.

Throughout this gripping audiobook, listeners will journey alongside Tarzan as he uncovers the mysteries of the Minunians, whose intricate society is filled with surprising twists and turns. Will he ally with them against a common enemy, or will his outsider status prove too great a barrier? The stakes escalate as Tarzan encounters not just physical battles but moral dilemmas that test his character and resolve.

Edgar Rice Burroughs crafts a tale rich with adventure, exploring themes of identity, loyalty, and the essence of civilization. Join Tarzan in this action-packed saga that challenges not only his physical prowess but his understanding of humanity itself. title: Blood at Dawn
author: Fire Eyes Media LLC
description:
On October 12, 1996, Kevin Carroll, Keith Chavez, and Donald Mikesh Jr. were brutally beaten and murdered inside a condominium on Chicago’s Southwest Side. Three people were arrested. Three people were convicted. Each was sentenced to three concurrent life sentences in prison.

The case may have ended in convictions, but nearly 30 years later, the story is far from over...

Blood at Dawn is a multipart true crime series hosted by Heather, Kevin Carroll’s daughter. She was just 13 years old when her father was killed. Now, for the first time, she is going back through the case that changed her life. Using court testimony, police records, and interviews with family members and people closely involved in the investigation, Heather reconstructs the hours leading up to the murders. She examines the investigation and trials that followed, as well as the conflicting stories told by the three people convicted of the crime. But this story did not end when the verdicts were read.

Blood at Dawn explores what happens to the families left behind once the headlines disappear and everyone else moves on. They are expected to live with what happened. Then, decades later, they discover that the people convicted are asking the state for mercy.

Nearly 30 years after her father walked into that condominium and never walked out, Heather is returning to the evidence, the memories, and the questions that never completely went away.

This time, she is telling the story...

title: But Mom Says She's Fine
author: Rachel Fortenberry
description:
"But Mom says she's fine."
Maybe she is. But you’re starting to notice things, and you’re not quite sure what comes next. 
But Mom Says She’s Fine is about the questions families face as their parents get older: caregiving, dementia, long-term care, money, legal decisions, and all the things nobody seems to explain until you suddenly need to know them.
Sometimes there’s a crisis: a fall, a hospital stay, a diagnosis, or a call from a neighbor. Other times, it happens slowly. Mom repeats herself more. Dad is struggling to keep up with the house. Someone probably shouldn’t be driving anymore. You know something is changing, but you don’t know whether it’s time to step in — or what stepping in would even look like.
Host Rachel Fortenberry is a Missouri elder law attorney who helps families through these decisions every day. She has also been the daughter sitting in a hospital wondering what her own family was supposed to do next.
Each episode, Rachel sits down with people who understand a different part of aging and caregiving — doctors, nurses, senior-care professionals, financial advisors, caregivers, attorneys, and families who have already been through it.
Together, they talk honestly about dementia, staying safely at home, long-term care, nursing homes, Medicaid and Medicare, powers of attorney, estate planning, family conflict, end-of-life decisions, and the conversations families often put off because nobody quite knows how to start them.
You won’t find magic solutions here. Aging is complicated, families are complicated, and there usually isn’t one perfect answer.
The goal is to help you recognize the questions sooner, understand the options in front of you, and feel more prepared for whatever comes next.
Because you don’t need to have every answer. You need to know what to ask, who to call, and what comes next.
New episodes weekly. Learn more at fortifiedelderlaw.com.

title: Profits & Parenting
author: Jordan Robb
description:
Some people are deep in building their business. Some are just getting started. Some haven't taken the leap yet, and some are wondering how they'll ever make it work alongside a family. This podcast brings you the real stories behind the wins, the losses, the money and the mindset it takes to build something that lasts.


Hosted by Jordan Robb, a property investor and developer who's spent over a decade building multiple businesses from scratch. These days he oversees what he's built and is on the hunt for what's next, from consulting other business owners to new ventures entirely. Three years ago that hunt got personal too, when he became a father, and an active one at that.


Every episode, Jordan sits down with a different guest to unpack how they built what they built. What they got right, what they got wrong, what changed everything, and what it really costs to build a business or a portfolio from nothing.


And woven through it, the part most business podcasts leave out. Where family fits into the story too, whether you're living it already or picturing what it might look like. Because ambition and family were never meant to compete. They blend.

title: The Mystery Of Golf: Psychology of the Game
author: Arnold Haultain
description:
Arnold Haultain dives into the peculiar grip that golf has on its players, unraveling the layers of psychology, emotion, and even philosophy behind every swing. Why do amateurs obsess over the perfect putt while seasoned pros grapple with their inner demons on the green? In 'Mystery Of Golf,' Haultain brings humor and sharp insight to the challenges golfers face, revealing how this seemingly simple game intertwines with the complexities of human nature.

Listen as he explores the quirks and conundrums that define the sport—from the thrill of sinking a long shot to the frustration of a missed opportunity. Haultain’s witty observations illuminate the tensions between ambition and acceptance, success and failure, all played out against the backdrop of a golf course. His reflections take you beyond the physical mechanics of the game, encouraging you to ponder how golf mirrors life’s broader struggles.

Join Haultain on this captivating journey that blends laughter with deep reflection. Whether you’re a weekend golfer or a curious observer, this audiobook promises to engage your mind and stir your emotions. Discover the hidden truths behind the game that captivates millions and find out why, for many, golf is more than just a sport—it's a lifelong mystery waiting to be solved.

title: AquaSumit's Podcast
author: AquaSumit
description:
Welcome to this episode of AquaSumit, where we dive deep into the world of freshwater aquascaping and plant care for hobbyists at every level. In today's conversation, we explore how live plants can transform a tank from a simple fish enclosure into a thriving, natural ecosystem. For anyone just starting out and feeling overwhelmed by the options, we recommend checking out this guide to aquarium carpet plants for beginners, which breaks down the easiest foreground species to establish a lush, green carpet without needing advanced CO2 setups or pressurized systems.

We also spend time discussing color and contrast in planted tanks — a topic that often gets overlooked by newer hobbyists chasing only greenery. If you want to add some visual pop to your setup without complicating your maintenance routine, this rundown of easy red aquarium plants is a great starting point, covering species that hold their color well even under moderate lighting and don't demand heavy dosing schedules.

Finally, for those looking to fill out a new tank quickly or recover from a plant die-off, we talk through some of the best options for rapid growth. This list of the fastest growing aquarium plants is a resource we point to often, since fast growers are also excellent at outcompeting algae and stabilizing water parameters early in a tank's life. Thanks for tuning in to AquaSumit — subscribe for more deep dives into the aquarium hobby, from beginner setups to advanced aquascaping techniques.

A Guided Emotional Intelligence Experience · Produced by Hill Media Group, LLC


What it is
The SEI MORE™ Podcast is a conversation series where emotional intelligence gets treated as what it actually is — not a soft skill, but a leadership skill, a survival skill, a relationship skill, and a legacy skill. Hosted by Dr. Donnette Green — renowned professor, leadership development practitioner, and Applied Emotional Intelligence Strategist — each episode turns lived experience and academic rigor into tools listeners can use the moment the episode ends.


The framework
Every episode is built on the seven pillars of the SEI MORE™ framework, which spell the name itself: Self-Awareness, Emotional Regulation, Intentionality, Motivation, Ownership of Impact, Relational Awareness, and Effective Influence. Guests and topics are explored through these pillars, so the show stays practical and structured rather than abstract.


The host
Dr. Donnette Green is the founder of Distinctly Guided, LLC and the creator of the SEI MORE™ framework. She's known for helping people master difficult conversations and lead themselves before they lead others — pairing scholarship with the honesty of someone who has lived the cost of emotional disconnection and built the path through it.


Format & guests
Real talk with real guests — authors, educators, entrepreneurs, artists, and community leaders — each bringing a story that illuminates one or more of the seven pillars. Conversations are candid, warm, and takeaway-driven, giving listeners something they can apply in their leadership, relationships, and everyday lives.

Each episode delivers real talk and real strategy: candid stories of failure and reinvention, conversations with women entrepreneurs who outlasted the quitters, and practical advice on growing your business, raising your visibility, and building collaborative community instead of competing alone. Expect solo episodes, guest interviews, and the kind of honest conversations about midlife entrepreneurship you can't find anywhere else.

How do women entrepreneurs over 40 grow a successful business?

description:
Daddy, what was vim?

For the last 80 years, the motive force of the computer revolution has been coding: the creation of software in formal languages by technical professionals exerting their intellect and their fingers. Sometime in 2025, this changed. To the extent coding remains a human activity, it is now education, craft, or leisure. The economically consequential coding is done by LLMs.

Keith Adams spent most of his waking hours coding, at VMware, Facebook, and Slack. You have run his code, probably today. He is also one of the generations of engineers whose work trained the clankers we now hand the keyboard to.

On After Coding, Keith sits down with the people who still think hardest about software to ask what the discipline becomes once the typing is no longer the point.

She helps people navigate the emotional recovery that follows life’s defining moments, guiding them as they rediscover hope, reclaim their strength, and embrace what’s possible. At the heart of Lora’s work is the belief that no matter how fierce the storm, the light that guides us forward has always been within us.

title: The VACATION
author: Minister Octavian D. Johnson
description:
Welcome to The VACATION, where your soul can find rest!
This channel is a place to hear, reflect, and grow through powerful messages rooted in the Word of God. Each sermon is designed to encourage your faith, challenge your thinking, strengthen your walk with Christ, and remind you of God’s presence and purpose. Whether you’re seeking encouragement, wisdom, or a deeper relationship with Jesus, we pray every message speaks to where you are and draws you closer to Him.
“Faith cometh by hearing…” — Romans 10:17

title: Tokenised Human
author: Rachael Bolton
description: Who are we when the work we built our lives and identities around is changing? Journalist Rachael Bolton speaks with technologists, researchers and policymakers about work, identity and the design decisions reshaping the world around us in the age of AI.

title: The Daily Pilgrim’s (Alex Rigby) Podcast

description: Forced to reinvent himself, Alex (a priest turned Entrepreneur in his 40's) stood aside from traditional religion and now lives an action packed but 'Simple' life. Join Alex on his adventures, as he shares the meaning of life, and how to live it!

title: Child’s Heart and Mind
author: Michael
description: The heart and the mind work to balance our actions. However, they can not do it alone. Support and guidance is necessary. This describes the most important function of an early childhood educator. With each experience comes an opportunity strengthen a child's heart and develop their mind. Only with our guidance and support can children hope to reach their full potential. It is my hope that with resources such as this podcast, I can help other early childhood educators with that goal.

title: Miracle Mindset
author: Pastor Sandy Mays
description: God has a good plan for your life. Many are wondering how to experience it. The first step is to take God's thoughts and allow His Word to create your vision and build your faith. Jeremiah 29:11

title: The Charlotte M. Brame Library
author: Charlotte M. Brame
description:
Enter a world of proud houses, secret sorrows, forbidden attachments, and hearts divided between love and duty.

The Charlotte M. Brame Library presents the novels of Charlotte M. Brame, celebrated in her day as Bertha M. Clay, read in full. Here are fortunes won and lost, promises broken, reputations imperilled, and passions that refuse to bow before rank, family, or convention.

For those who delight in grand romances, hidden histories, noble sacrifices, and the delicious uncertainty of what the next chapter may reveal, these stories invite you once more into the drawing rooms, gardens, and shadowed corridors of Victorian melodrama.

title: A Darkish Cinema Podcast
author: Ash and Dreams, LLC
description:
Join James and Sunni as they discuss, dissect, and deconstruct Horror and Horror “Adjacent” films from the points of view of a Film Studies student (James) and a casual moviegoer (Sunni).
In addition to conventional horror, we will also be examining:
-Dark and sometimes High-Concept Comedies
-Dark and Surrealist Fantasies
-Thrillers, Suspense, Drama and Adventures that include supernatural and/or psychological elements
-Murder Mysteries
-Crime and Film Noir, especially those surrounding murder and/or murder plots
-Folk and Fairy Tales
-Serial Killers
-Descents Into Madness and Insanity
-Etc.

title: Between The Seen And Unseen
author: Marcia
description:
Between the Seen Unseen is a space for deeper conversations about who we are beneath the identities, relationships, expectations, and experiences that have shaped us.


Hosted by Marcia, the Podcast explores self-discovery, relationships, healing, emotional awareness, spirituality, intuition, personal transformation, and the unseen parts of our inner world.


Together, we explore what happens when you begin to see yourself differently-when old identities no longer fit, when awareness expands, and when you learn to trust what you feel, know, and experience within.


This is a space for reflection, honest conversations, and understanding yourself beyond the surface.


Because there is more to who we are that what can be seen.

title: The Community Podcast: Scoop the Urban Loop
author: Tiffany Menke
description:
Welcome to Scoop the Urban Loop, part of The Community Podcast, where we keep you connected to the people, places, and stories shaping Central Iowa's northwest communities. Covering Urbandale, Clive, Johnston, Grimes, Dallas Center-Grimes, Windsor Heights, and surrounding communities, this is where you can get the scoop on what's happening throughout the area.
Hosted by Tiffany Menke, Scoop the Urban Loop brings local leaders, chambers, business owners, organizations, and community members into the conversation. Hear directly from the people behind the businesses, projects, ideas, and initiatives helping these communities grow and thrive.
From new businesses and community developments to local events, opportunities, and people you should know, Scoop the Urban Loop gives you an inside look at what's happening close to home. It's about sharing useful information, celebrating local stories, and making it easier to stay connected to your community.
Tune in to Scoop the Urban Loop and get connected to what's happening in your community. By bringing local voices, businesses, leaders, and neighbors together, we're creating conversations that build stronger communities and keep Central Iowa connected.

title: Beyond Command
author: Sean Maloy
description: Elevating Fire and EMS Leadership. Our target auduence is firefighters, fire officers, EMT's, patramedics, dispatchers, students, and any others with an interest in the fire service and how we work. The show is not about telling war stories or tactics on specific fires; its about everything else. Culture, leadership, training, professional development. But, above all: excellence in emergency services. The host is a 35+ year veteran of the fire service, spending 20 years as a chief officer.

title: Monster Talk
author: Ezestical
description:
For the longest time ever, I have been wanting to talk to someone about My Singing Monsters and tell them literally everything I know about the game. Every friend I know does not like the game, and it made me lose hope in ever doing this. Fortunately, there is someone I can endlessly talk about the game to; the internet!

Each episode, join me in a ton of silly QNA sessions, games, and talk about everything My Singing Monsters!

title: EACH ONE TEACH ONE
author: Imiuswi Aborigine
description: Each One Teach One is a podcast hosted by Imiuswi Aborigine exploring the lessons that shape our lives. Through reflections, stories, music, creativity, and conversations with inspiring people, each episode asks one simple question: What can we teach, and what can we still learn? Whether you're an artist, educator, entrepreneur, elder, student, or seeker, this podcast is an invitation to pass knowledge forward—one person at a time.

title: The Amelia B. Edwards Library
author: Amelia B. Edwards
description:
Come with me into a world of untrodden valleys, haunted roads, distant cities, ancient temples, and lives governed by passions no less mysterious than the past itself.

The Amelia B. Edwards Library presents the works of the remarkable Victorian novelist, traveller, Egyptologist, and teller of ghost stories, read in full. From the shadowy suspense of her supernatural tales to her journeys along the Nile and through the mountains of Europe, these are books written with curiosity, wit, courage, and an inexhaustible appetite for discovery.

Open the first page, and the journey begins.

title: The Point by Edgar Rene

description: Behind every career worth talking about, there’s one moment that changed the whole direction — this is where we go find it. Sometimes it’s a person. Sometimes it’s a moment. The Point brings you into the rooms, shops, and studios where the work actually happens, so the lessons land wherever you’re clocking in.

Discover the flavors everyone craves with Most Wanted Recipes - the podcast that celebrates the world’s most beloved dishes and ingredients. Inspired by the bestselling Most Wanted Recipes cookbook series, each episode dives into 45 irresistible recipes built around one iconic theme - from comfort food classics to global favorites.

Cook. Share. Savor.

The recipes everyone wants - now in your ears.

description:
Step into the unknown and come with me into the void. The 144 explores psychic perception, channeling, intuition, consciousness, synchronicities, angels, interdimensional beings, and experiences beyond ordinary perception. Hosted by Caro Marx, a psychic, channeler and medium, the podcast combines personal experiences, spiritual teachings and explorations of what becomes possible when we learn to perceive what we were never taught to see.
Inspired by the prophecy of the 144,000 — who are we, why are we here, and what happens when we begin to remember?
Enjoy!

author: Cassidy Curtis
description: East Coast Unsolved dives into the darkest mysteries, chilling crimes, and unexplained events from Canada's East Coast and beyond. Each episode explores unsolved disappearances, cold cases, strange legends, and forgotten stories through careful research and compelling storytelling. Whether you're fascinated by true crime, local history, or the unexplained, East Coast Unsolved uncovers the questions that still have no answers and the stories that refuse to be forgotten.

description: Buy Original offers premium imported shoes from globally trusted brands, ensuring 100% authenticity and quality in every pair. Our mission is to make branded footwear accessible to everyone who values comfort, durability, and style. title: Petty Cases
author: Almost Friday Media
description: Stand-up comedians and friends Willie Simon and Steve Furey host a comedy courtroom show from Almost Friday Media and Friday Beers where they take on absurd, low-stakes and petty disputes that would never make it anywhere near a real court. Each episode, Willie and Steve argue real cases submitted by the audience and fully commit to arguing both sides as opposing lawyers, regardless of how ridiculous the case may be. A rotating celebrity guest serves as judge, hearing the arguments, examining the evidence, and ultimately delivering a final verdict. With big personalities and ridiculous arguments, Petty Cases delivers nonstop laughs in a courtroom where the stakes are low, the grudges are high and justice is whatever the judge says it is.

title: Trauma for Breakfast
author: Stacey
description: Trauma For Breakfast is a crowded table of wounded children, parents, spouses, caregivers and weary souls. Together we join in honest conversations about the behaviors and challenges of parenting children with trauma.There's always room for one more at the table to share in the stories, science and healing as we learn to better understand and care for each other. We are a table without shame or judgement because life can be hard and lonely and we all know, that breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

title: Let's Plan Your Wedding!
author: Abby Gordon and Tamar Frieze
description:
Welcome to Let's Plan Your Wedding, the podcast where we are YOUR wedding planners, and every episode is a planning meeting just between us. 


Over the last 25 years, Abby Gordon and Tamar Frieze have planned New England's most celebrated weddings through their acclaimed company, Two Eight Four Weddings & Events. From intimate gatherings at private estates to elaborate seven-figure weddings in tents, museums, ballrooms and beyond, Abby and Tamar (and Abby’s mother,  wedding planning pioneer Linda Matzkin of Hopple Popple) have seen and done it all!


And now, Abby and Tamar are opening their office to you: their newest client! They will walk you through your wedding planning process step by step, episode by episode, offering the same expertise, advice, anecdotes and opinions that they share with their own clients. Oh, and their proprietary wedding planning templates and downloads. 


So pop in your earbuds, step into our podcast office and we'll take care of the rest. 


Okay. Are we ready? Let's plan your wedding!

Each episode takes a piece of media—film, novel, comic, myth, or cultural moment—and treats it like a living text. Not a review, not a recap, but a guided, intimate exploration of why it mattered, what it meant, and how it changed the person telling it.

The New Data Economy is brought to you by Transcend.

title: Warriors Within: Stories of Sickle Cell
author: RJ Deed
description:
FSCDR TV presents Warriors Within: The Stories of Sickle Cell Disease a podcast series dedicated to raising awareness about Sickle Cell Disease, and more importantly, celebrating the strength and resilience of sickle cell warriors and their families. Through heartfelt stories, expert insights, and supportive dialogues, the podcast aims to create a community of understanding, hope, and empowerment.
The goal is to raise awareness and educate the general public about Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) – its causes, symptoms, challenges, and treatments. To empower the community by providing a platform for sickle cell warriors and their families to share their stories, creating a space for support, understanding, and empowerment. To bridge the gap and connect the general public, sickle cell warriors, medical professionals, and researchers, fostering a community of solidarity and mutual respect.

title: Dark History
author: Shohan
description:
Dark History takes you deep into the hidden, disturbing, and mysterious chapters of the past. From forgotten crimes and unsolved mysteries to secret societies, deadly conspiracies, lost civilizations, strange disappearances, and shocking historical events, each episode uncovers stories that history books often leave behind.

Step beyond the familiar version of history and explore the events, people, and secrets that shaped the world in unexpected ways. 

Whether you're fascinated by true crime, historical mysteries, unexplained events, ancient secrets, or the darker side of human history, Dark History brings you compelling stories designed to keep you listening until the very end.

 History has a dark side. Some stories were never meant to be forgotten.

🎧 New episodes featuring mysterious, disturbing, and forgotten stories from history.

title: Christian Authors: Beyond the Stack

description:
The world of publishing is changing fast—and getting your book published is only the beginning.

Join host Russ Scalzo, president of Lighthouse Productions, a nonprofit 501(c), and its publishing and promotional arm, Out of the Stack. This podcast is designed to help authors navigate today’s crowded book marketplace. We’ll share practical publishing and marketing tips, explore new ways to help readers discover your work, and talk honestly about what authors can do to increase their visibility without breaking the bank.

You’ll hear interviews with authors, conversations about their writing and publishing journeys, and real-world ideas for promoting books through video, YouTube, social media, book trailers, interviews, and other emerging opportunities.

Whether you’re working on your first book or wondering how to breathe new life into one you’ve already published, our goal is simple: to give authors the knowledge, encouragement, and tools they need to succeed in today’s changing marketplace.

You wrote the book. Now let’s help take it out of the stack and put it into readers’ hands.

Out of the Stack — Join the Revolution.

It’s about what comes after survival — when the crisis may still exist, the insight is there, and you’re learning that healing alone isn’t the same as living. This podcast explores the distinction between surviving and living: how to inhabit your body, desire, and agency while disentangling from chaos without bypassing it. For sensitive, trauma-aware people, and survivors who value depth over platitudes. Beyond Healing is about the tender, beautiful, and sometimes painful process of coming home to yourself — and choosing to live Beyond Healing.
